response.reason: The kernel reproduces the exact single-rounding formula: int64 product (max ~2^62, no overflow), bias 2^(30+r), arithmetic right shift (floor for negatives), and the intermediate ±255 clamp is provably harmless because final clamping to [-128,127] makes any |R|>255 map identically (R>255 implies R+z≥128, R<-255 implies R+z≤-129). Halfway cases round toward +inf as required.
